item.title: Arab parties back Eisenkot, giving him a majority of recommendations for prime minister
item.description: With 67 of 120, he's expected to get the first chance to form Israel's next government.

item.title: State Department and White House deny report that Rubio is preparing to resign
item.description: Officials called The Independent's report that he could leave to prepare a 2028 run fabricated. Sergio Gor, named as a possible successor, called it nonsense.
